messages:
Theo K: hi team — Theo joining CS today! quick list please: HubSpot prod vs sandbox, Aircall/Dialpad seat, the CS playbook copy, and the one-page objection cheat. also who owns Gong access for call review? :wave:
Renee (IT): welcome Theo :tada: I can provision HubSpot prod. if you need sandbox for experiments say so. Sent HubSpot invite to theo@redwood (check spam). Aircall or Dialpad depends on region — which are you in?
Theo K: I'm US-west. prefer Aircall but fine with Dialpad if that's standard. also MFA question: do we use Okta push or SMS?
Aisha (sales-ops): US-west = Aircall by default. Aircall will auto-populate HubSpot activities if you use the cs-templates script. Objection cheat is named "OBJECTION_BRIEF_CS_v3" in /playbooks/cs/cheatsheets. Gong access is handled by Marco (CS).
Marco (CS): looping in myself — granted you to Gong prod (call-review) + call-library. Also added you to the "CS First Week" calendar pack: listen to 3 calls (onboarding, renewal, escalation).
Onboarding Bot: Action required: complete "Sales/CS Tools" checklist: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-cs within 48 hours to keep seats active.
Renee (IT): HubSpot invite sent, use Okta push for MFA (setup at https://okta.redwood/setup). Aircall seat requested — you'll get a setup link from aircall@notifications. If you don't get it in 10m tell me your device.
Theo K: got HubSpot invite, Okta set up. Aircall link landed but setup fails with an error "device not supported" on MacBook M1. anyone seen that?
Renee (IT): hiccup is known — Aircall desktop app has an M1 build behind a flag. For now use Aircall web or mobile; i'll escalate for desktop fix. Which browser did you try?
Theo K: tried Chrome stable. web version works, mobile too. thanks. where's the CS playbook canonical file? I found multiple versions.
Aisha (sales-ops): canonical is "cs_funnel_v5_master" in /playbooks/cs/masters. We keep older versions suffixed with vX_ARCHIVE. Use v5_master for scripts and handoffs. I'll add a pinned note in the folder about the objection brief name.
Marco (CS): also FYI recordings are on by default for training; if you want recordings off for a specific customer, follow the rec-off procedure in the playbook (quick steps in the handoff checklist).
Theo K: perfect — joined Gong and call-library. thanks everyone :raised_hands: I'll book the 1:1 playbook walkthrough with @Marco.
Renee (IT): Aircall desktop team pinged. If you need Dialpad temporarily we can swap seat types. LMK.
Theo K: web is fine for now. appreciate the quick help! :rocket:
